name: Clear Creek County Lodging Tax Voting Area
scopeNote: Registered electors in Clear Creek County outside the Town of Georgetown, as expressly specified by Resolution R-26-55.

name: Montezuma County Lodging Tax Voting Area
scopeNote: Registered electors in Montezuma County outside the City of Cortez. Current county lodging question excludes Cortez; the official Cortez sample omits it, consistent with C.R.S.§30-11-107.5(3).
